# External integrations and dependencies

<!-- provenance -->
> **Extracted fact** from the code at commit `71fae62`, produced by static analysis with no AI model. Safe to rely on.


This codebase depends on or integrates with these external platforms, services and apps: AWS, Anthropic, PostgreSQL, SQL database (SQLAlchemy).

Deterministically extracted from package manifests, imports, environment variable usage, URLs, routes and deployment files. No LLM was used.
